items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I mean he was such a big star, that just being a musician playing with him, like myself coming in from the outside, you have to know the situation other than his immediate guys that had worked with him for years and knew him good.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a groovy guy. He was a nice guy. Every time — he and I sort of hit it off. I mean he was such a big star, that just being a musician playing with him, like myself coming in from the outside, you have to know the situation other than his immediate guys that had worked with him for years and knew him good. But a guy like me coming in adding on, didn’t know him at all and I’d just make the rehearsals without him. You play the music and the conductor and so forth, and you play the music so you don’t…
